pages.text: The Greenhouse rapidly grows crops. Supply the required seeds, water, and energy.$(br)$(br)Drops follow the mature crop, including changes made by your modpack. JEI shows the expected amounts; actual drops may vary. Melons produce slices.$(br)$(br)Fertilizer is optional for supported crops. Fertilized recipes consume more water and energy for 50% more harvests.

pages.title: Construction
pages.text: 7 × 7 growing bed with a five-block pitched glazed roof. Twenty farmland cells flank a water channel; roof lights and ridge ventilation explain the growing function. All four ports stay at ground level.$(br)$(br)20 frame, 60 framed glass, 7 grow light, 24 panel, 2 vent, 20 farmland, 5 water. Plus the controller and 4 hatches shown in the preview.$(br)$(br)Original 2.5 builds still form unchanged. Do not move a controller or loaded hatch during an active cycle. Build the new design separately, or finish and empty the old machine before rebuilding.
